summary.text: Daniel Frick is the Republican candidate for Colorado House of Representatives District 53 in the November 3, 2026 general election, having advanced from the Republican primary on June 30, 2026.
In a Ballotpedia survey, he described himself as an Air Force veteran and businessman raising four children in northern Fort Collins.

paragraphs.text: In a Ballotpedia survey, Daniel Frick said he served in aircraft maintenance in the Air Force and later deployed to Afghanistan as a contractor.
He said he holds a bachelor's degree in business management and an MBA, and has lived in Colorado since 2010.
He said he is a paid caregiver for his son through Medicaid.
Frick said his campaign messages include making Fort Collins affordable for working families, protecting parental rights in education, and fiscal responsibility at the state capitol.
